positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of software for modeling and analysis of IBM Storage Systems performance.
Planning, design, development, testing and documentation of software applications to analyze the performance storage systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Radio for GMC cars.
Development of embedded software that controls the car’s radio, among other functionalities: auto-diagnostic, error handling, navigation, volume control, hardware control, playback control (time elapsed, time remaining, fast forward, etc).
Responsibilities: Design and develop the software modules that control the radio’s functionalities. 

Also I was responsible of designing, documenting and implementing the unit test procedures, in order to assure the quality of the software developed, this involves white box tests as well as black box tests.
